t: What he feared after Uhud, and what he did not
a: وَإِنِّي وَاللَّهِ مَا أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ تُشْرِكُوا بَعْدِي، وَلَكِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ تَنَافَسُوا فِيهَا
p: Wa innī wa-Llāhi mā akhāfu ʿalaykum an tushrikū baʿdī, wa lākinnī akhāfu ʿalaykum an tanāfasū fīhā
m: By Allah, I do not fear that you will associate others with Allah after me. But I fear that you will compete with one another over it.
